title: Sisi Meets Kushner in El Alamein as Hamas Delegation Holds Parallel Cairo Talks on Gaza Ceasefire
detail: President Abdel Fattah el-Sisi received Jared Kushner, US President Trump's son-in-law and a member of the Gaza Board of Peace, in New Alamein on August 16, 2026, in the presence of Foreign Minister Badr Abdelatty and General Intelligence Service chief Hassan Rashad. The two sides stressed the need for all parties to fulfill their obligations under the Gaza ceasefire agreement reached at the October 2025 Sharm el-Sheikh Peace Summit, amid mounting disagreement over the deal's second phase after Israel rejected aspects of the 15-point roadmap and linked withdrawal to Hamas disarmament. Kushner conveyed greetings from Trump and praised Egypt as a key US partner in the region. In parallel, a Hamas delegation led by Khalil al-Hayya met separately with Rashad in Cairo the same day to discuss consolidating the ceasefire and briefing mediators on alleged Israeli violations of the roadmap.

media.caption: Sisi meets Jared Kushner in New Alamein to discuss Gaza ceasefire implementation

title: Egypt Joins Seven-Nation Statement Condemning Israeli Rejection of Gaza Roadmap
detail: Egypt's Foreign Minister Badr Abdelatty joined counterparts from the UAE, Qatar, Jordan, Indonesia, Pakistan, Turkey, and Saudi Arabia in a joint statement issued August 16, 2026 condemning Israel's declared rejection of the roadmap to complete implementation of the US-backed Comprehensive Plan to end the Gaza conflict, endorsed by UN Security Council Resolution 2803, as well as Israel's rejection of Palestinian statehood. The eight ministers said the roadmap — the product of extensive mediation efforts by Egypt, Qatar, Turkey, the US, and the Board of Peace — was accepted by Palestinian factions and covers weapons decommissioning, Israeli force withdrawal, deployment of an International Stabilization Force, and transfer of administrative authority to a National Committee for the Administration of Gaza. The statement said Israel's rejection amounts to a repudiation of the plan and placed responsibility for obstructing peace on Israel, while calling for continued US engagement to enforce compliance.

media.caption: Egypt joins seven other nations condemning Israel's rejection of the Gaza peace roadmap
